annotations.title: Instant online valuation and rent estimate

description: Get an instant automated estimate of a UK property's sale value AND its monthly rent (use it for "what is my house worth" and "how much rent could I get"). Requires the owner's real name, email and phone, the postcode, property type and bedrooms; optionally bathrooms and house name/number. Creates a real lead: the nearest estate agent on OpenMoov (an independent agency; OpenMoov has no agents of its own) receives the owner's details and may contact them about a full valuation — tell the user that BEFORE calling, and only call with genuine details and their explicit agreement. The user is also emailed a copy of the valuation at the address given. Estimates are automated ranges from comparable data, not a formal valuation; when no estimate can be produced the local agent prepares one instead. For an in-person appointment use request_valuation.

condition.description: The owner's own description of its condition: needs_work | average | good | refurbished. Ask the owner; without it average is assumed.

house_name_number.description: House name or number — lets us match the home's EPC so the estimate uses its real floor area. Without it a typical size for the bedroom count is assumed and the estimate is less certain.

postcode.description: Full UK postcode of the property, e.g. "CT21 4DA"
